newsitem.title: NORWAY: Protest attack on Italian embassy in Oslo.
newsitem.headline: Protest attack on Italian embassy in Oslo.

text.p: Vandals daubed "Murderers" on the Italian embassy in Norway overnight in protest against the deaths of Albanian refugees in a collision at sea, NTB news agency reported on Monday.
It said 20 to 30 youths threw paint bombs, sprayed slogans and broke windows in protest at the sinking of an Albanian boat crammed with refugees on Friday.

Albania says 83 people died in its worst maritime disaster in modern times. Italy says it was an accident caused by the Albanian vessel but many of the 34 survivors have accused the Italian navy of ramming their boat to stem a tide of refugees.

NTB said it had received a fax about the embassy attack in which a small group called Antifascist Action claimed responsibility and said: "We did this in answer to the brutal treatment of the Albanian refugees by Italy."
